findings.note: Since h = v₀²/2g, tripling the height triples the SQUARE of the launch speed: v′² = 3v₀², so v′ = √3 v₀, which is option (a). The stated answer 3 v₀ would give nine times the height, not three times.
Dividing 3h = v′²/(2g) by h = v₀²/(2g) gives v′²/v₀² = 3, a pure number; the printed line equates a dimensionless ratio to a speed and is false as written.
